sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat(
    'SELECT ingestion_config_id, watermark_field, last_watermark_value, ',
    'last_successful_batch_id, last_successful_pipeline_run_id ',
    'FROM control.pipeline_watermarks ',
    'WHERE ingestion_config_id = ',
    string(pipeline().parameters.p_ingestion_config_id),
    ';'
)

value.value: @concat('SFTP incremental requires watermark_field=last_modified_time. Config=', pipeline().parameters.p_watermark_field, ', state=', activity('lkp_current_watermark').output.value[0].watermark_field, '.')

message.value: @concat('SFTP incremental requires watermark_field=last_modified_time. Config=', pipeline().parameters.p_watermark_field, ', state=', activity('lkp_current_watermark').output.value[0].watermark_field, '.')
